name: Elder Triple Screen Ratchet
note: Elder's three screens with the screen-3 detail that is usually dropped: the entry is a resting stop one tick beyond the PREVIOUS bar's extreme, re-priced every bar, so while the pullback continues the buy stop walks DOWN with it and only fills at the turn. Tide is the MACD histogram slope on bars resampled to a higher timeframe; the wave is a short EMA of Force Index that must oppose the tide.
source: Alexander Elder, 'Trading for a Living' (1993) and 'Come Into My Trading Room' (2002) -- the Triple Screen system. Screen-3 trailing buy-stop rule ('place the buy order one tick above the previous day high... the order also moves down, one point above the high, until a buy opens or the main trend reverses') as documented at mql5.com/en/blogs/post/731016 and asktraders.com's Elder triple screen guide.
code:
def _ema(vals, period):
    """EMA over a list that may contain None; None until it has a value."""
    k = 2.0 / (period + 1.0)
    out = [None] * len(vals)
    e = None
    for i, x in enumerate(vals):
        if x is None:
            out[i] = e
            continue
        e = x if e is None else e + k * (x - e)
        out[i] = e
    return out


def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    v = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    htf = max(2, int(ctx.p.htf))
    walk_max = max(1, int(ctx.p.walk_max))
    off_atr = float(ctx.p.off_atr)

    # ---- SCREEN 1: the tide. Resample to blocks of `htf` bars, MACD hist. --
    # block b covers bars [b*htf, (b+1)*htf-1] and is COMPLETE at its last bar,
    # so a bar i may only read blocks whose last bar is <= i.
    nb = n // htf
    hc = [c[(b + 1) * htf - 1] for b in range(nb)]
    fast = _ema(hc, 12)
    slow = _ema(hc, 26)
    macd = [None if (fast[b] is None or slow[b] is None) else fast[b] - slow[b]
            for b in range(nb)]
    sig = _ema(macd, 9)
    hist = [None if (macd[b] is None or sig[b] is None) else macd[b] - sig[b]
            for b in range(nb)]

    tide = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        b = (i + 1) // htf - 1          # last completed block at bar i
        if b >= 1 and hist[b] is not None and hist[b - 1] is not None:
            if hist[b] > hist[b - 1]:
                tide[i] = 1
            elif hist[b] < hist[b - 1]:
                tide[i] = -1

    # ---- SCREEN 2: the wave. Force Index and its short EMA. ---------------
    fi = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        fi[i] = v[i] * (c[i] - c[i - 1])
    fi2 = _ema(fi, max(1, int(ctx.p.fi_ema)))

    # ---- Wilder ATR, computed here because family_init cannot read series --
    per = 22
    tr = [None] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        pc = c[i - 1]
        tr[i] = max(h[i] - l[i], abs(h[i] - pc), abs(l[i] - pc))
    atr = [None] * n
    acc = 0.0
    for i in range(1, n):
        if i <= per:
            acc += tr[i]
            if i == per:
                atr[i] = acc / per
        else:
            atr[i] = (atr[i - 1] * (per - 1) + tr[i]) / per

    # ---- SCREEN 3: the resting stop order that walks with the pullback ----
    out = [0] * n
    armed = 0          # +1 buy stop resting, -1 sell stop resting, 0 none
    age = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if armed:
            if tide[i] != armed:                 # the tide turned: cancel
                armed = 0
            elif age > walk_max:                 # unfilled too long: cancel
                armed = 0
            else:
                a = atr[i - 1] if i >= 1 else None
                off = (off_atr * a) if (off_atr > 0 and a) else 0.01
                if armed > 0 and h[i] >= h[i - 1] + off:
                    out[i] = 1                   # the walking buy stop filled
                    armed = 0
                elif armed < 0 and l[i] <= l[i - 1] - off:
                    out[i] = -1
                    armed = 0
                else:
                    age += 1                     # re-price against this bar
        if armed == 0 and out[i] == 0 and fi2[i] is not None:
            # arm only when the wave OPPOSES the tide
            if tide[i] > 0 and fi2[i] < 0:
                armed, age = 1, 0
            elif tide[i] < 0 and fi2[i] > 0:
                armed, age = -1, 0

    ctx.sig = ctx.series(out, "elder_trigger")
    ctx.tide = ctx.series(tide, "weekly_tide")


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sig[i]
    return s if s else 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Out on the first completed higher-timeframe bar whose histogram
    slope turns against the position."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    t = ctx.tide[i]
    if not t:
        return False
    d = -1 if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "short" else 1
    return t != d
